name: forge-monorepo
description: my-forge — A Fast, Go-Powered Code Editor by Yantra Works

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "DAEMON,RENDER,DESKTOP" -c "cyan,blue,magenta" "cd services/forge-daemon && go run cmd/forge-daemon/main.go" "npm run dev --workspace=@my-forge/renderer" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run dev --workspace=@my-forge/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@my-forge/shared-protocol && npm run build --workspace=@my-forge/design-system && npm run build --workspace=@my-forge/renderer && npm run build --workspace=@my-forge/desktop && npm run build:daemon
scripts.test: npm run test:go && npm run test:ts && npm run test:flows
